question: The polygon enclosed by the solid lines in the figure consists of $ 4$ congruent squares joined edge-to-edge. One more congruent square is attached to an edge at one of the nine positions indicated. How many of the nine resulting polygons can be folded to form a cube with one face missing?
view_evidence: original_montage_1.png or original_montage_2.png; individual originals also viewed for all designed questions.
specific_assessment: All9 extra-square positions independently assessed using exact hinge normals in folding_audit.json; exactly4,5,6,7,8,9 valid. One two-edge source-to-position5 correspondence tested; all dashed candidate boundaries remain dashed.
